span: Family and team history · multiple decades
story: The Williams family story adds personal context to the team’s title-winning cars. Placed near Frank Williams’ 1986 accident and the team’s championship campaign.

title: Senna
story: Asif Kapadia’s archive-led portrait follows Senna’s F1 career and rivalry with Prost. An emotionally powerful interpretation to compare with the race record.

title: Senna
story: Actors recreate Senna’s life and racing career. This is the drama series, distinct from the 2010 documentary; scenes and dialogue are dramatised.

title: Schumacher
story: A family-supported portrait with archival footage and interviews. Watch after the Ferrari title run for a more personal perspective on the seven-time champion.

title: Brawn: The Impossible Formula 1 Story
story: Keanu Reeves guides the story of a team saved from Honda’s withdrawal and transformed into a champion. An especially useful companion to the two 2009 races.

title: Formula 1: Drive to Survive
story: Start with season one alongside 2018, then advance one series per racing year. The edited storytelling benefits from comparison with full race context; it is not a chronological race-by-race record.
label: Open Netflix

title: F1 The Movie
story: A modern paddock setting with invented drivers Sonny Hayes and Joshua Pearce. Real circuits and familiar faces provide the setting; its results belong to fiction.

title: The Seat
story: Follow the decision to put Antonelli in Hamilton’s former Mercedes seat. Watch before the 2026 entries to meet a driver whose importance is about to grow.
